name: map-create-update
comment: WP-2.6. ItemMap.onUpdate through InventoryPlayer.decrementAnimations (ItemStack.updateAnimation) every tick. Generated world, seed 123 (grass near (-26, 66, -58)); the player (id 0) dropped at (-22, 70, -58) holds a map with damage 0 (hotbar 0, selected) and one with damage 5 (slot 5). Tick 0: map_0 is not in the MapStorage and SaveHandlerMP has no files, so getMapData takes getUniqueDataId("map") = 0 and makes map_0 (centre: the world spawn (0, 0), scale 3, dimension 0, dirty); the second map gets id 1 (its damage becomes 1) and map_1; map_5 never exists. Both register the player (updateVisiblePlayers); only the selected map is drawn (updateMapData: the columns congruent to step mod 16 within 16 pixels of the player, 8 x 8 blocks per pixel, loading the chunks it samples). t 100: a floating 16 x 16 sheet of red wool and a 16 x 8 sheet of sand (fill, y 90) change the top blocks the map samples; t 100-159 the player walks forward (+z). map_data of map_0 at t 0, 4, 9 (columns still being drawn) and of maps 0, 1, 5 every 20 ticks (colours as BLAKE3, scale, centre, dimension, step).
